title: Pipe chart true scale-to-fit
description:
The pipe shaft was sized to 100% of the whole chart block, so it drew through the end sphere, and remarks were still getting clipped. The shaft now only spans the middle row between the From/To spheres. The chart also measures its natural height and uniformly scales the whole diagram — header, spheres, pipe, and all remarks — so everything always fits in the panel with nothing cut off.

Who is affected: everyone on the private server, and on SaaS after Push.
changeLog: Pipe shaft now ends at the From/To spheres instead of running past them.
Entire pipe chart uniformly scales to fit the panel height.
All observation remarks stay visible — no more bottom clipping.
Track height reserves space for every remark before scaling.
